blocks.text: TACLOBAN CITY — Police are continuing the probe into the shooting of a known anti-mining advocate at his residence in MacArthur, Leyte, on Nov. 6 as an environmental group condemned the attack and called for the immediate identification and arrest of those responsible. The victim, identified by police as Jesus Cabias, 53, a farmer and resident of Barangay Liwayway, was watching television on his house’s terrace at around 9:30 p.m. when an unidentified gunman shot him. According to the initial police report, Cabias managed to flee to the comfort room and hide after being shot. He was later taken by the […]...
